name: Customer Context Folderbase
description: Optional starting guidance only when customer context needs its own explicit security or retention boundary.

questions.prompt: What should this customer context folderbase be called?
Why does this customer context need its own security, ownership, retention, or lifecycle boundary instead of an Account Workspace?
What customer relationship and outcome should this folderbase make understandable?
What is true about the account, active work, stakeholders, and risks now?
What is the next concrete account action?

artifacts.x-purpose: Approved account context, stakeholders, and relationship history.

artifacts.content:
# ${folderbase_name}

## Purpose
${purpose}

## Boundary reason
${boundary_reason}

## Current state
${current_state}

## Navigate
- `Account/` — approved customer context, stakeholders, and relationship history.
- `Projects/` — pointers to separately governed project folderbases; do not duplicate their canonical content here.
- `Meetings/` — customer conversations owned by this boundary.
- `Deliverables/` — approved customer-facing outputs owned by this boundary.

## Operating rules
- Use an Account Workspace composition instead when the authorized engagement and project folderbases already supply the needed customer view.
- Keep this separate folderbase only while its explicit boundary reason remains true.
- This template does not grant the customer, a partner, or an agent access; every share remains explicit.

## Unresolved work
- Next action: ${next_action}
